title: Export assigned legacy score lyrics as GPIF track lyrics
scope: Project ordered Song.Lyrics lines onto their selected GPIF track without merging unrelated lyric scopes or mutating the input song.
acceptance: For a valid TrackIndex and a track without lyrics, export the exact ordered legacy lines and starting-measure offsets; verify the index-base conversion with a real legacy fixture.

If existing Track.Lyrics are equivalent, emit one copy. If they conflict, keep explicit track lyrics authoritative and report the omitted conflicting score lyrics; strict policy must reject an unallowed conflict.
Retain empty/Unicode text and nonzero offsets with exact wire and Go reparse evidence; use pinned AlphaTab for supported lyric text/dispatch behavior.
Unassigned legacy lyrics remain an explicit loss and invalid track references remain diagnosed. Keep beat lyrics and Beat.Text independent; remove only the resolved blanket score-lyrics omission.
exclusions: Do not concatenate conflicting representations or silently assign unassigned lyrics to track zero.

reproduction.instructions: For a valid TrackIndex and a track without lyrics, export the exact ordered legacy lines and starting-measure offsets; verify the index-base conversion with a real legacy fixture. See the linked investigation decision and review receipt for the confirmed baseline.

evidence.detail: Public contract; linked matrix cases are in obligation.
Public contract; linked matrix cases are in obligation.
implementation-ready: The legacy selected-track lines have a GPIF Track.Lyrics destination already supported by both parsers; export currently omits Song.Lyrics unconditionally.
Focused receipt from the normal pinned consumer and public exporter, with source hashes and scoped loss boundaries.

resolution: Assigned Song.Lyrics lines project in order to the selected GPIF track, with exact offsets and empty/Unicode text. Existing equivalent track lyrics deduplicate; conflicting explicit track lyrics win with a scoped omission. Unassigned lyrics remain omitted and invalid references are rejected. GP8 import exposes projected lines as Track.Lyrics. Pinned dispatch retains supported syllables; any beat lyric element suppresses all track dispatch and receives a per-track consumer loss. Escaped lyric text with boundary whitespace receives a precise normalization. Export remains partial. Fresh independent review and combined full gates/probe remain pending with root; GitHub stays open.
verification: Failing-before public API and raw pinned-consumer regressions reproduced, then pass after implementation.
Focused public API, pinned consumer, runtime semantic inventory and exact wire checks pass.
Full conformance/check.sh, capability probe and prek are assigned to root integration; independent exact-commit review pending.
